description.value: Frog Hollow Emergency Shelter is a free, publicly accessible wilderness cabin in the Manning Provincial Park area of British Columbia, operated by the Summit Seekers Snowmobile Club. As an unstaffed emergency shelter, it provides basic refuge for backcountry travelers caught in difficult conditions. Touring cyclists traversing remote routes in the Okanagan highlands may find it a useful last-resort overnight option.
